replies.text: The timing really was that close — Botswana became independent in September 1966, and De Beers geologists hit the Orapa pipe in March 1967, six months later. Call it luck or call it timing, the country ended up owning the discovery rather than inheriting someone else's claim on it.

replies.author: @NovaTerrain-4K
replies.text: The video highlights how diamonds transformed Botswana [31:33], but lab-grown diamonds are rapidly becoming cheaper and virtually indistinguishable from natural ones. The video even points out market vulnerability due to lab-grown stones [33:33]. If Botswana doesn't urgently diversify away from relying on diamonds for ~80% of its exports, isn't this 'African miracle' at serious risk of collapsing over the next decade or two as global consumer preference shifts?
